articles.title: Speeding Truck Rams Toll Booth in Chitrakoot, 22-Year-Old Shivam Shukla Killed on Duty
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Chitrakoot (Uttar Pradesh) – A tragic accident occurred late Tuesday night at the Jorwada toll plaza under Mau police station, where a cement-laden truck rammed into the toll booth, killing 22-year-old employee Shivam Shukla on the spot.

body.html:
Chitrakoot (Uttar Pradesh) – A tragic accident occurred late Tuesday night at the Jorwada toll plaza under Mau police station, where a cement-laden truck rammed into the toll booth, killing 22-year-old employee Shivam Shukla on the spot.

Two others were injured — Prabhat Shukla was critically hurt and referred to the district hospital, while Pankaj Pandey suffered minor injuries. The truck driver fled the scene, but the vehicle has been seized by police.

Shivam, the sole breadwinner of his family, lost his life while on duty. A case has been registered at Mau police station, and investigation is underway.

articles.title: Mango Dispute Turns Violent in Kushinagar: Village Pradhan Seen Firing Gun in Viral Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kushinagar (Uttar Pradesh) – A minor dispute over mango plucking in Jawahi Narendra village escalated into violence, as village head Bablu Dewan allegedly led an armed assault. The incident took place in the Taryasujan police station area.

body.html:
Kushinagar (Uttar Pradesh) – A minor dispute over mango plucking in Jawahi Narendra village escalated into violence, as village head Bablu Dewan allegedly led an armed assault. The incident took place in the Taryasujan police station area.

The clash began when Bablu Dewan’s men entered Ramnaresh Singh’s orchard to pluck mangoes, triggering a confrontation. When Ramnaresh and his family objected, the Pradhan and his supporters allegedly attacked them with sticks and later chased villagers while firing shots.

A video of the incident, now viral on social media, shows Bablu Dewan running with a gun in hand. Two people were seriously injured in the attack. Victims claim the police took action against them instead of arresting the accused, who remain at large.

articles.title: Clash in Muzaffarnagar: BKU Tomar Protesters Dragged, Tractors Seized – FIR Being Prepared
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Muzaffarnagar (Uttar Pradesh) – Tension flared outside Nai Mandi police station as Bharatiya Kisan Union (BKU) Tomar group workers were forcibly removed by police during a protest. BKU leaders allege that police misbehaved with them and used force without provocation.

body.html:
Muzaffarnagar (Uttar Pradesh) – Tension flared outside Nai Mandi police station as Bharatiya Kisan Union (BKU) Tomar group workers were forcibly removed by police during a protest.

BKU leaders allege that police misbehaved with them and used force without provocation. Over 10 tractors were seized and several protesters detained. Authorities are preparing to file an FIR under multiple sections, including obstruction of government work.

Videos and photos of the incident are now going viral on social media, fuelling outrage among farmer groups.

articles.title: Wife Got Govt Job, Then Abandoned Husband & Child: Bihar Man Alleges Illicit Affair, Files FIR
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Vaishali (Bihar) – A shocking case has emerged from Vaishali district where a man, Pankaj Kumar Sah, has filed a police complaint against his wife Pooja Kumari, accusing her of leaving him and their 4.5-year-old daughter after securing a government job in the Fire Brigade Department.

body.html:
Vaishali (Bihar) – A shocking case has emerged from Vaishali district where a man, Pankaj Kumar Sah, has filed a police complaint against his wife Pooja Kumari, accusing her of leaving him and their 4.5-year-old daughter after securing a government job in the Fire Brigade Department.

Pankaj alleges he sold his mother’s jewellery to fund Pooja’s education and help her get the job. However, after her posting to Triveniganj (Supaul district), she allegedly got involved with fellow fireman Rahul from Ara, currently posted in Saharsa.

According to Pankaj, when he objected to the affair, Pooja drove him and their daughter out. He also claims to have found an objectionable video of Pooja with her lover, and alleges that her family threatened to frame him in a false case if he didn’t divorce her.

An FIR has been demanded and police are investigating the matter.

articles.title: Hardoi Horror: Man Bites Off Wife’s Nose Over Phone Call with Lover
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hardoi (Uttar Pradesh) – A shocking incident from Deoria Prasiddha Nagar village under Hariyawan police station limits, where a man bit off his wife's nose after seeing her talking to her alleged lover on the phone. The brutal attack occurred on Wednesday evening.

body.html:
Hardoi (Uttar Pradesh) – A shocking incident from Deoria Prasiddha Nagar village under Hariyawan police station limits, where a man bit off his wife's nose after seeing her talking to her alleged lover on the phone. The brutal attack occurred on Wednesday evening.

According to reports, Ramkhilavan, son of Rampal, saw his wife Pooja speaking to a young man from the same village. An argument broke out, which quickly escalated into violence. In a fit of rage, Ramkhilavan bit off Pooja’s nose with his teeth.

Despite her injuries, Pooja managed to inform the police. She was rushed to a community health centre and later referred to the district hospital. Due to the severity of her condition, doctors further referred her to Lucknow Medical College. Her severed nose was sent along in a plastic bag for possible reattachment via plastic surgery.

Police have arrested the accused and registered a case under serious sections. The incident has created panic in the village, and police say a thorough investigation is underway.
